rows.text: Filter hands through Celes's entry looting, buff your entire board with +1/+1 counters whenever creatures enter from the graveyard, and close out games with Abdel flicker loops or persist machine guns.

guide.title: Hand sculpting and graveyard entry counter buffs

rows.name: Celes, Rune Knight
rows.text: when Celes enters the battlefield, discard any number of cards, then draw that many cards plus one. Whenever one or more other creatures you control enter, if one or more entered from a graveyard or was cast from a graveyard, put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.

rows.name: Squee, Goblin Nabob
rows.text: returns to your hand from the graveyard at the beginning of your upkeep, providing free, reusable discard fodder for Celes's entry ability every turn.

rows.name: Ephemerate
rows.text: flickers Celes for a single white mana to discard unneeded cards and draw fresh resources with rebound on the following turn.

rows.name: Cloudshift
rows.text: one-mana instant flickering Celes or a reanimated creature to reset triggers or protect them from targeted removal.

rows.name: Gravecrawler
rows.text: costs {B} to cast directly from your graveyard as long as you control a Zombie, triggering Celes's board-wide +1/+1 counter buff on every cast.

rows.name: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Animate Dead
rows.text: with Abdel Adrian in your graveyard, cast Animate Dead targeting Abdel. When Abdel enters, his exile trigger targets Animate Dead. Exiling Animate Dead forces Abdel to be sacrificed. When Abdel leaves the battlefield, his return trigger brings Animate Dead back to the battlefield, targeting Abdel again. Each iteration creates a 1/1 white Soldier token and counts as a creature entering from the graveyard, triggering Celes to place infinite +1/+1 counters across your entire army!

rows.name: Abdel Adrian, Gorion's Ward + Necromancy
rows.text: operates identically to the Animate Dead loop at instant speed.

rows.name: Murderous Redcap + Goblin Bombardment + Celes, Rune Knight
rows.text: sacrifice Murderous Redcap to Goblin Bombardment to deal one damage to any target. Persist returns Redcap from the graveyard with a -1/-1 counter. Because Redcap entered from the graveyard, Celes triggers and puts a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, including Redcap. The +1/+1 counter and -1/-1 counter cancel out via state-based actions, resetting persist. Repeat for infinite damage to defeat all opponents.

rows.name: Putrid Goblin + Phyrexian Altar + Celes, Rune Knight
rows.text: persist loop functioning identically; generates infinite colored mana and infinite +1/+1 counters on your team.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Twinflame
rows.text: cast Twinflame targeting any creature you control, hold priority, and flash in Dualcaster Mage to copy Twinflame targeting Dualcaster. Repeat for infinite hasty 2/2 attackers.

rows.name: Dualcaster Mage + Molten Duplication
rows.text: redundant two-mana copy combo.

rows.name: Demonic Tutor
rows.text: unrestricted tutor to assemble Abdel Adrian, an Altar, or protection.

rows.name: Jeska's Will
rows.text: explosive red ritual and impulsive card draw.

rows.name: Smothering Tithe
rows.text: taxes opposing card draws to accumulate massive Treasure reserves.

rows.name: Tainted Pact
rows.text: every land in the deck has a completely distinct name (utilizing separate normal and snow-covered basics), allowing Tainted Pact to tutor any card without risk of fizzling.

rows.name: Grand Abolisher
rows.text: silences all opponent interaction during your turn to guarantee uninterrupted combo execution.

rows.name: Silence
rows.text: one-mana instant preventing opponents from casting spells on your winning turn.

rows.name: Deflecting Swat
rows.text: zero-mana redirection spell while controlling Celes.

Keep opening hands with two to three lands, early mana acceleration (Sol Ring, Dark Ritual, Talismans), and card draw or discard outlets (Faithless Looting, Squee, Goblin Nabob). Cast Celes on turn three to sculpt your hand, discard large threats or combo pieces into the graveyard, and execute an Abdel Adrian loop, Persist loop, or Dualcaster line on Turn 6 or later.
House rules apply: infinite combo loops and compact wins are restricted to Turn 6 or later. Earlier turns focus on establishing board presence, hand sculpting, and graveyard setup.
